skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the basics of financial institutions, types of risks, and the consequences of risks.
Analyze the interplay between different types of risks.
Identify and assess major risks faced by businesses and financial institutions.
Choose preventive and mitigating tools for different types of risks.
Develop models and strategies for risk prevention.
Practice teamwork, group discussions, and presentation skills.
Understand legal regulations related to risk management.
Use models to measure significant risks for businesses and financial institutions.
Measure and manage financial risks such as interest rate and liquidity risks.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve risk-related problems.
